full_judgment: 3. Petitioner contested the case by filing a written objection denying the material allegations and stating that the case holding recorded in RS Khatian Nos. 47, 31 and 153 in the names of Haralal Ghose, Priolal Ghose and Jatindra Lal Ghose and Surendra Lal Ghose who entered into an agreement with the petitioner on 27.2.65 to sell their 8 annas share of the said property of the said holdings and they having failed to amicably execute and register the kabala in favour of the petitioner he filed Title Suit No. 232 of 1970 in the Court of Madaripur for specific performance of contract; that the suit was decreed up to the appellate Court and accordingly, petitioner obtained a registered kabala in execution of the said decree; that father of the pre-emptors did not get any land in these case holdings by his alleged purchase and, as such, the pre-emptor-opposite parties are not co-sharers in the said holdings of property Nos. 1 and 2; that the petitioner improved the case land by cutting earth worth Taka 10,000.00 and constructed huts, raised garden and residing there; that the present value of the case land will be Taka 50,000.00; that the case is not maintainable without depositing increased value of the land and costs of improvement.
